title: 도시 이름 읽기: 서울, 부산, 제주
objective: You can read five Korean city names aloud and match each with its English spelling.
summary: Read Korean city names like 서울, 부산 and 제주 on maps and signs.

task.title: Read the city names
task.line: Say each name aloud first. Then choose, write or answer.

words.meaning: Busan (a port city in the south)
Daejeon (a city in the middle of Korea)
words.exampleMeaning: A train ticket to Daejeon, please.

letters.as: Like 'u' in 'cup'. 서울 is two syllables, [seo-ul], not 'sole'.

letters.sound: [e]: these two vowels sound the same today

exercises: Choose the right English spelling: ① 서울 (Seoul / Soul) ② 대구 (Daegu / Dagu) ③ 대전 (Daejeon / Daejon)
Do the two syllables sound the same? Write Yes or No: ① 대 / 데 ② 서 / 소 ③ 제 / 재
Write the city name in Hangul: ① Busan ② Daegu ③ Jeju
Read the train screen and answer with a city name: 서울 → 천안 → 대전 ① Where does the train start? ② Where does the train stop last?
answers: ① Seoul ② Daegu ③ Daejeon
① Yes ② No ③ Yes
① 부산 ② 대구 ③ 제주
